name: Mitti (formerly SafetyCulture)
oneLiner: Frontline operations platform, renamed from SafetyCulture to Mitti in August 2026, for digital inspections, checklists, corrective actions, training, sensors and asset tracking across sites.
bestFor: Multi-site restaurant and hospitality operators that want food-safety, hygiene and brand-standard inspections, issue follow-up and staff training in one mobile app, with a free tier for small teams.

updates.text: Brought on the team behind Twine, a Sydney AI startup, to speed up its agentic AI work.
Bundled monthly AI credits into every plan (Free, Premium and Enterprise), per a pricing tracker.

SafetyCulture rebranded as Mitti, repositioning as one operations system for frontline work (software, sensors, supply ordering and insurance) and adding an AI Assistant, AI issue creation, monitoring agents and 5 Star Benchmarking, a single score per location for multi-site operators.

features: Digital inspections and checklists with photos, notes and scoring, plus a large public template library
Corrective actions and issue reporting assigned to staff with due dates
Analytics across locations, including 5 Star Benchmarking for one score per site
Training courses and lessons delivered on mobile
Temperature and environmental sensors with alerts
AI assistant, AI-created issues and agents for routine monitoring
Integrations marketplace and Mitti Supply automatic reordering from inspections

pricing.text: Free plan for up to 10 team members. Premium about $24 per seat per month billed annually or $29 monthly (A$29 in Australia); lower-cost Lite seats for completing inspections and training. Enterprise is quoted (site-based). Figures from third-party listings; vendor pricing page not confirmed after the rebrand.

notes: RENAMED: SafetyCulture became Mitti on August 11, 2026 (Business Wire / mitti.com media release; also itbrief.com.au and startlandnews.com). Review heading and website link (safetyculture.com) should be updated to Mitti / mitti.com. The insurance arm SafetyCulture Care is now Mitti Insurance. Twine acquihire (April 2026) seen only in an aggregator tear sheet and trade-press headline; source null. Unconfirmed reports of layoffs in May 2026 left out. Dropped from current review: 'typically starts in the low hundreds per month for small teams' (not supported; there is a free plan and per-seat pricing). Customer quotes for Fishbowl, Trippas White Group and Sodexo come from a search snippet of the vendor's restaurant management page; Snooze is a full customer story (old safetyculture.com URLs may redirect to mitti.com). Scale claim (2 million workers, 80,000 organizations) is vendor-reported.
